title: Preservation of the dual-rail invariant
statement: Let $n$ be the number of input variables, choose an input coordinate, and suppose a list of gates and a state of straight-line statements and rails satisfy the dual-rail invariant. If every argument of a new gate refers to an input or an existing gate vertex, and the gate has at most two arguments, then after processing that gate the resulting statements and rails satisfy the dual-rail invariant for the list with the new gate appended.
hypotheses_covered: The current statements and rails satisfy the dual-rail invariant for the existing gate list
Every argument of the new gate has index less than the number of inputs plus the number of existing gates
The new gate has at most two arguments
